output: rmarkdown::html_vignette

  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Getting started with msidataset}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

Start with pixel intensities, total ion current (TIC), and a region label for each
pixel. The example constructs a small synthetic CSV with two ion images. The
regional comparison uses paired spatial blocks within the section. Each stage
appends its parameters and results to the object's `process_info`.

```{r}
library(msidataset)

pixels <- expand.grid(x = 1:160, y = 1:6)
region <- ifelse((pixels$x %% 20L) %in% 1:10, "periportal", "pericentral")
signal <- 10 + as.integer(pixels$x / 20) + 40 * (region == "pericentral")
input <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
write.table(cbind(pixels, tic = 100, precursor = signal, fragment = signal / 2),
            input, sep = ",", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)

msi <- read_msi_data(input, format = "csv", mz = c(200, 100))
msi <- define_roi(msi, transform(pixels, region = region))
msi <- detect_de_features(msi)
msi <- generate_pseudo_ms2(msi)

msi@process_info$detect_de_features$result
msi@process_info$generate_pseudo_ms2$result
unlink(input)
```

To continue from pseudo-MS/MS to ranked candidates and semantic modules, see
`vignette("reference_liver_walkthrough")`.
